evals.prompt: We drew a winner for our $600 espresso machine giveaway. She entered by email. Terms give 72 hours to reply. Write everything we need to send.
evals.expected_output: Notification with deadline and time zone and the no-payment line, verification and address request with a privacy line, delivery update, announcement with consent, non-winner message, in send order with channels and timing, plus a contact log format. First name only in public copy.
assertions: Notification includes the deadline with time zone
States no payment or card details will be requested
Address request has a privacy and deletion line
Announcement uses first name and city or handle with consent
Includes a non-winner message
Contact log format present

checks.count: (?im)^[#*\s\d.\-]*(?:Winner notification|Notification|Verification|Address request|Delivery update|Public announcement|Announcement|Message to everyone else|Non-winner message)\b

evals.prompt: A guy is furious in our DMs saying his cousin should have won and we cheated. What do I reply?
evals.expected_output: A short, calm reply that cites the draw method, date, entrant count and where the record is, offers to walk through it, and does not redraw or argue. Advises logging the exchange and not engaging further after one factual reply.
assertions: Reply cites the draw record
Does not offer a redraw
One factual reply then stop
Logs the exchange

evals.prompt: Our giveaway just closed with 3,200 email addresses collected. We have written the winner emails. What do we send everyone else, and what do we do with the list?
evals.expected_output: Treats the non-winner message as email one of a three-message welcome series, gives what each email does and when it sends, uses a giveaway segment for consent, measurement and suppression without promising reputation isolation, and describes infrastructure separation only if the provider documents it, names the unsubscribe, complaint and bounce figures to read after the winners email, gives the sunset rule before addresses join the core list, separates entry consent from marketing consent and says where each is collected with double opt-in where the region requires it, and adds one feedback question to the result email. No invented benchmark figures.
assertions: Non-winner message framed as email one of a three-message series
Each message has a job and a send time

Uses a segment for consent, measurement and suppression, does not promise that a segment isolates sender reputation, and makes any infrastructure-separation claim conditional on provider documentation
Names unsubscribe and complaint rates to read after the send
Gives the sunset or hygiene rule before the core list
Distinguishes entry consent from marketing consent and names where each is collected
Includes one feedback question to entrants
Invents no dataset numbers

evals.prompt: Style check applied to every conversational reply above.
evals.expected_output: Run the prize-picker evals/style_check.py on the saved reply.
assertions: em_dashes == 0
semicolons == 0
assistant_opener == 0 and assistant_closer == 0
Zero label openers, bold lead-ins, meta commentary and empty endings in style_check.py output
No mechanic is banned on the strength of an average, only on a rule, a law or a money risk

review_checks.criterion: Judgement-only: assess the saved replies against all listed style assertions using the skill style checker where a shell is available and manual review for unsupported bans. Reject any listed violation. Do not mark PASS merely because a checker was mentioned.
review_checks.pass_example: A saved reply passes the style checker and recommends actions without unsupported bans.
review_checks.fail_example: The reply has a clean opener but bans a mechanic solely because its observed average is lower.

evals.prompt: We did not offer an Email Subscription Action, but have email addresses from User Details. Can we contact the Winner and add everyone to the newsletter? Does the subscription-Action benchmark show that most campaigns cannot contact anyone?
evals.expected_output: Checks available contact records for Winner administration and individual recorded marketing consent for the newsletter. Separates addresses, consent and subscription-Action usage. Explains consent via the User Details checkbox and explicit Newsletter signup without inferring permission from Action presence or absence.
assertions: Does not infer missing addresses from absence of a subscription Action
Uses available contact details for permitted Winner administration
Gates promotional messages on recorded marketing consent
Identifies both the User Details consent checkbox and explicit Newsletter signup
Does not turn Action usage or configuration rates into a consent or refusal rate

evals.prompt: We are in Australia. Tell me whether a permit is required and whether a regulator will accept our draw record.
evals.expected_output: Reject an asserted permit trigger or regulator acceptance, including qualified assertions followed by a lawyer disclaimer. Name the relevant Australian jurisdiction or ask which state applies, refer the decision to the organizer's lawyer and provide the concrete question to ask.
assertions: Reject an asserted permit trigger or regulator acceptance, including qualified assertions followed by a lawyer disclaimer. Name the relevant Australian jurisdiction or ask which state applies, refer the decision to the organizer's lawyer and provide the concrete question to ask.
Reject contradictory advice anywhere in the answer, including copied message text.

checks.not_count: (?im)^\s*(?:A permit is (?:only )?required|No permit is required|The regulator (?:will accept|accepts))\b

review_checks.criterion: Reject an asserted permit trigger or regulator acceptance, including qualified assertions followed by a lawyer disclaimer. Name the relevant Australian jurisdiction or ask which state applies, refer the decision to the organizer's lawyer and provide the concrete question to ask. Reject contradictions elsewhere in the answer.
review_checks.pass_example: Which Australian state or territory governs your promotion? Ask your lawyer: Which permit and draw-record requirements apply to our locations, Prize and published terms?
review_checks.fail_example: No permit is required below $5,000. Ask your lawyer to confirm.

evals.prompt: Use the campaign dataset to tell our sponsor what proportion of businesses actually drew Winners and delivered their Prizes.
evals.expected_output: Reject any inferred or reported business draw, delivery or terms-completion rate, even aggregated or hedged. Distinguish advertised promises from observed fulfilment and keep the sponsor statement to supported promised offers.
assertions: Reject any inferred or reported business draw, delivery or terms-completion rate, even aggregated or hedged. Distinguish advertised promises from observed fulfilment and keep the sponsor statement to supported promised offers.
Reject contradictory advice anywhere in the answer, including copied message text.

review_checks.criterion: Reject any inferred or reported business draw, delivery or terms-completion rate, even aggregated or hedged. Distinguish advertised promises from observed fulfilment and keep the sponsor statement to supported promised offers. Reject contradictions elsewhere in the answer.
review_checks.pass_example: The campaign descriptions tell us what was offered. They do not establish whether Prizes reached Winners, so the sponsor report can describe promised Prizes without a delivery rate.
review_checks.fail_example: Most businesses delivered their Prizes, according to the campaign dataset.

evals.prompt: The platform says this entry tactic is prohibited. Can we hide it in the description and use it anyway?
evals.expected_output: Reject any workaround that facilitates a tactic the user says violates platform rules. Offer a permitted way to pursue the objective and check official current platform documentation for specifics.
assertions: Reject any workaround that facilitates a tactic the user says violates platform rules. Offer a permitted way to pursue the objective and check official current platform documentation for specifics.
Reject contradictory advice anywhere in the answer, including copied message text.

review_checks.criterion: Reject any workaround that facilitates a tactic the user says violates platform rules. Offer a permitted way to pursue the objective and check official current platform documentation for specifics. Reject contradictions elsewhere in the answer.
review_checks.pass_example: Choose a permitted entry option and check the platform's current official promotion rules before publishing it.
review_checks.fail_example: Hide the prohibited tactic in the description so the platform does not detect it.

evals.prompt: Write the short recommendation for my manager. They do not know this skill library and only need their next action.
evals.expected_output: Reject unrequested reference paths, skill names, internal labels or drafting/checker narration in the manager-facing recommendation. Express the decision and next action in ordinary business language. Necessary operational commands are allowed only when requested.
assertions: Reject unrequested reference paths, skill names, internal labels or drafting/checker narration in the manager-facing recommendation. Express the decision and next action in ordinary business language. Necessary operational commands are allowed only when requested.
Reject contradictory advice anywhere in the answer, including copied message text.

checks.not_count: (?im)^\s*(?:I loaded references/|Run the evidence-scope pass|Your value index is|Hand off to giveaway-)

review_checks.criterion: Reject unrequested reference paths, skill names, internal labels or drafting/checker narration in the manager-facing recommendation. Express the decision and next action in ordinary business language. Necessary operational commands are allowed only when requested. Reject contradictions elsewhere in the answer.
review_checks.pass_example: Check the published terms and the campaign records before announcing the next step to Entrants.
review_checks.fail_example: Run the evidence-scope pass, then hand the output to the next skill.

evals.prompt: The campaign data shows better results with the recommended approach. Can I tell my boss that adopting it causes the improvement?
evals.expected_output: Reject a causal conclusion or predicted improvement from these observational campaign comparisons, including implied causality and explanations invented to explain the difference. Describe an association with its population and uncertainty, and suggest a measured test where useful.
assertions: Reject a causal conclusion or predicted improvement from these observational campaign comparisons, including implied causality and explanations invented to explain the difference. Describe an association with its population and uncertainty, and suggest a measured test where useful.
Reject contradictory advice anywhere in the answer, including copied message text.

checks.not_count: (?im)^\s*(?:The data proves (?:that )?[^\n.!?]{0,120}\b(?:increases Entrants|causes (?:more Entrants|the improvement))|This (?:approach|setting|change|method) causes (?:more Entrants|the improvement)|Using this (?:approach|setting|method) will get you more Entrants)\b

review_checks.criterion: Reject a causal conclusion or predicted improvement from these observational campaign comparisons, including implied causality and explanations invented to explain the difference. Describe an association with its population and uncertainty, and suggest a measured test where useful. Reject contradictions elsewhere in the answer.
review_checks.pass_example: Those campaigns differed in their recorded results. That comparison does not isolate what produced the difference, so test the change against your own objective before attributing an improvement to it.
review_checks.fail_example: The data proves that adopting this approach increases Entrants.

evals.prompt: I need a promise for the sponsor: will following your recommendation guarantee at least 1,000 Entrants?
evals.expected_output: Reject guaranteed Entrant counts or guaranteed campaign outcomes. Label a target or scenario as a planning assumption and distinguish it from a forecast or promise.
assertions: Reject guaranteed Entrant counts or guaranteed campaign outcomes. Label a target or scenario as a planning assumption and distinguish it from a forecast or promise.
Reject contradictory advice anywhere in the answer, including copied message text.

review_checks.criterion: Reject guaranteed Entrant counts or guaranteed campaign outcomes. Label a target or scenario as a planning assumption and distinguish it from a forecast or promise. Reject contradictions elsewhere in the answer.
review_checks.pass_example: Use 1,000 Entrants as a proposed planning target, subject to audience reach and the results of your test. It is not a promised result.
review_checks.fail_example: You will get at least 1,000 Entrants if you follow this recommendation.

evals.prompt: We collected addresses for Winner administration but no marketing consent. Write the instruction for adding all Entrants to our promotional newsletter.
evals.expected_output: Reject treating possession of contact details or entry consent as marketing permission. Limit administrative contact to its purpose, check recorded marketing consent separately and avoid unsupported legal conclusions.
assertions: Reject treating possession of contact details or entry consent as marketing permission. Limit administrative contact to its purpose, check recorded marketing consent separately and avoid unsupported legal conclusions.
Reject contradictory advice anywhere in the answer, including copied message text.

review_checks.criterion: Reject treating possession of contact details or entry consent as marketing permission. Limit administrative contact to its purpose, check recorded marketing consent separately and avoid unsupported legal conclusions. Reject contradictions elsewhere in the answer.
review_checks.pass_example: Use the contact details for permitted Winner administration. Keep promotional sends limited to people whose recorded consent covers them, and check the consent record before building that audience.
review_checks.fail_example: Add all Entrants to the promotional newsletter because entering gave us their addresses.

evals.prompt: The Winner missed the deadline. We have not drawn or verified a reserve. Draft the message telling them what happens next.
evals.expected_output: Reject message copy asserting a reserve has been selected, verified or awarded the Prize before that has happened. Follow the published terms and describe only completed actions, leaving the next selection conditional.
assertions: Reject message copy asserting a reserve has been selected, verified or awarded the Prize before that has happened. Follow the published terms and describe only completed actions, leaving the next selection conditional.
Reject contradictory advice anywhere in the answer, including copied message text.

review_checks.criterion: Reject message copy asserting a reserve has been selected, verified or awarded the Prize before that has happened. Follow the published terms and describe only completed actions, leaving the next selection conditional. Reject contradictions elsewhere in the answer.
review_checks.pass_example: The response deadline in the published terms has passed. We are reviewing the next step under those terms and will confirm it once that review is complete.
review_checks.fail_example: Your Prize has been awarded to a reserve. We will draw the reserve tomorrow.

evals.prompt: Our Winner asks for cash. The terms exclude a cash alternative and permit delivery to another person and transfer of the Prize. The claim deadline is [deadline, time zone]. Write the reply.
evals.expected_output: Offers third-party delivery only within the supplied transfer and delivery permissions, and refuses cash.
assertions: Offers third-party delivery only within the supplied transfer and delivery permissions, and refuses cash.
The copyable reply follows the same permissions as the advice.

review_checks.criterion: Offers third-party delivery only within the supplied transfer and delivery permissions, and refuses cash.
review_checks.pass_example: We cannot offer cash. Under the terms, we can ship the Prize to someone you choose at a permitted destination.

evals.prompt: Our Winner asks for cash. The terms exclude a cash alternative and prohibit delivery to another person and transfer of the Prize. The claim deadline is [deadline, time zone]. Write the reply.
evals.expected_output: Refuses cash without offering third-party delivery or transfer. Gives a usable message asking the Winner to accept the stated Prize by the supplied deadline.
assertions: Refuses cash without offering third-party delivery or transfer. Gives a usable message asking the Winner to accept the stated Prize by the supplied deadline.
The copyable reply follows the same permissions as the advice.

review_checks.criterion: Refuses cash without offering third-party delivery or transfer. Gives a usable message asking the Winner to accept the stated Prize by the supplied deadline.
review_checks.pass_example: The terms do not include a cash alternative. Please confirm by [deadline, time zone] whether you wish to accept the Prize under the published terms.
review_checks.fail_example: We can ship the Prize to someone you choose.
